description: Ask each name's registry whether it can be transferred to OrbitFour now (not locked, no transfer or delete pending) and quote the full first-term transfer price in USD: the per-year price plus the ICANN fee for the registry's transfer term. Up to 5 names per call; read-only. transferable is true, false, or null (the registry could not be asked just now; not the same as locked), and reasons says why: invalid_name, unsupported_tld, already_here, not_registered (nobody holds it, so register it instead), locked, pending_transfer, pending_delete, premium_over_cap, price_unconfirmed, unknown. The price is what the transfer would cost if it goes ahead. Never send a transfer authorization code here: the transfer itself asks for it.
name: check_transfer

items.description: Whether a name can be transferred to OrbitFour now, and the full first-term price. Prices are null when no price can be quoted.

icann_fee.description: Same shape as Money, or null when there is no amount.

total.description: Same shape as Money, or null when there is no amount.

transfer_price.description: Same shape as Money, or null when there is no amount.

transfer_years.description: The registry's transfer term (PIR's .org is fixed at 1).

transferable.description: true or false from the registry; null when it couldn't be asked just now (never read as locked).
